name: Lossless Claw
description: Context engine plugin that preserves full session memory without compaction loss. Uses sliding-window assembly with intelligent summarization of older turns instead of discarding them.

maxContextTokens.description: Maximum token budget for assembled context (default: uses agent contextTokens)

recentTurnsFullPreserve.description: Number of most recent turns to always include uncompressed (default: 8)

summaryMaxTokens.description: Max tokens for the rolling summary of older turns (default: 2048)
